mechanism: An unusually large chain-specific activity shock can attract investor attention and capital away from competing ecosystems. If reallocation is not instantaneous, the token of the activity leader may outperform the other chain tokens over the following three days.
source_dependency: CAR_SOURCE_FULL_V02 required; source-blocked means no outcomes.

signal.transform: natural log of positive daily count
signal.zscore: (log_activity_t - mean(log_activity over t-28..t-1)) / sample_std over t-28..t-1
signal.leader: chain with highest z on event day
signal.overlap: one 3-day event at a time; any event before active event exits is ignored

outcome.peers_return: equal-weight mean of the other two log returns
outcome.note: Predictive relative-return study only; no executable shorting/PnL claim.

no_rescue: No inversion to mean reversion after outcomes.
No dropping a losing chain after outcomes.
